questions.question: When the risen Jesus suddenly stood among His frightened disciples, what did they think they were seeing?
After rising from the dead, Jesus asked His disciples for something to eat. What did they give Him?
After rising from the dead, Jesus said something would be proclaimed in His name to all nations. What was it?

answers.text: A new law for every land

questions.question: While Jesus was blessing His disciples at Bethany after rising from the dead, what happened to Him?

answers.text: He was carried up into heaven
He sent them out two by two
He broke bread with them again
